full_name: Diana Sorensen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Diana Sorensen is the dean of arts and humanities at Harvard University’s Faculty of Arts and Sciences, where she is also the James F. Rothenberg Professor of Romance Languages and Literatures and a professor of comparative literature.
